capture.final_message:
Rewrite the four large propositions in ordinary notation. They are all standard polynomial identities, so prove each independently and assemble the result with `⟨iff_of_true … …, iff_of_true … …⟩`; the implications do not need to use their hypotheses.

The useful intermediate goals are:

- `leval r p = smeval p r`.
- `smeval (X^n * p) x = x^n * smeval p x`.
- `smeval ((monomial n r) * p) x = r • (x^n * smeval p x)`.
- `coeff (f • g) n = ∑ (i,j) ∈ antidiagonal n, coeff f i • coeff g j`.

The first three follow by unfolding evaluation into the finite coefficient sum and using the evaluation rules for `X`, powers, multiplication, and monomials. The last is the Cauchy-product formula for the polynomial action on `PolynomialModule`, indexed by pairs with `i + j = n`.

The seemingly unusual `NatPowAssoc` and `SMulCommClass` assumptions are essential for the nonassociative target: they justify reassociating powers of `x` and commuting coefficient scalar actions through multiplication. After translating the elaborated terms back to notation, existing `Polynomial.smeval` and `PolynomialModule` lemmas should discharge these goals directly.
